en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a calm street scene with cobblestone roads and rows of 19th- or early 20th-century European buildings. Several people and a dog can be seen along the street. Signage on one building reads 'Installationsgeschäft Karl Holzhausen.' The text on the postcard identifies the location as 'Nerchau a. Mulde. Hauptstraße' and the publisher as 'Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
